b: For today’s prompt, write a strange poem. Or, if you prefer, write a weird poem. Something a little out of the ordinary, or something a lot out of the norm. Maybe a strange occurrence…or a weird dream. Something someone said that felt just a bit off. There are plenty of opportunities to write normal poems, but for at least today, think abnormal poems.
Remember: These prompts are springboards to creativity. Use them to expand your possibilities, not limit them.

Here’s my attempt at a Strange Poem:

Tiger the cat started talking to the birds,
and the birds started talking back,
through the window screen,
which I had open,
because it was such a nice autumn day,
and they told him,
“It’s so nice out here;
you should join us,”
to which Tiger quipped,
“Believe me,
I would if I could,
but my human over here keeps me cooped up,”
and I said,
“Hey now,”
which made Tiger jump,
and the birds flew away chanting,
“He heard us;
he heard us;”
and Tiger immediately started cleaning himself,
like he didn’t say a thing,
like he didn’t jump when I did,
like it was a normal Thursday morning.
